note: Curiosity RAD is the only surface radiation dosimeter on Mars. Measurements are rover-local point values, not a spatial map across the ops box. Suit and terrain sky-view shielding are not modeled.
claim_boundary: Context card only — never rendered as a spatial hazard heatmap. Modeled walk dose scales the Observed GCR baseline by excursion duration (Scenario).
source: Hassler et al. 2014, Science 343:1244797, doi:10.1126/science.1244797; Zeitlin et al. 2018, GRL, doi:10.1029/2018GL077760; PDS PPI MSL-M-RAD-2-EDR-V1.0; NASA-STD-3001 Vol 1
